hints.label: nudge
hints.text: Look at how the database executes the two queries, not at how the Python around them is written. SQLite can tell you its plan.

hints.label: pointer to the signal
hints.text: Run EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN on RECENT_SQL and SUMMARY_SQL (python app/bench.py prints one). Is it a SCAN or a SEARCH? Which columns do the queries filter on, and which columns are indexed?

hints.label: near-solution
hints.text: Add an index in app/schema.py whose leading column is customer_id (adding created_at as the second column also removes the sort). Then confirm the plan says SEARCH ... USING INDEX (customer_id=?).
